test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true even if they do not conform to real - world knowledge, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/ follow from the statements. 

**Statements : **

1. Some streams are rivers. 

2. No river is a lake. 

**Conclusions : **

I. No stream is a lake. 

II. Some rivers are streams.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follow
Both conclusion I and II follow

solution:
__**Least Possible Venn diagram:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bc6ebcad60e9c1b1a28dc1df58b863bfa5a050c1f1bb7da9ae1883f9ccb6309.png] 

**Conclusions:**

**1. **No lake is stream → Does not follow (it is possible but not definite)

This possibility can be shown using the below Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7614b1b650207cbab5dcaa7caf2ef4ebd0f05ba7c200a4714a9bb6d76ad24cb.png] 

**2. **Some rivers are streams →** **Follows (According to statement 1 some streams are rivers so, some rivers are definitely "streams").

Here, **Only conclusion 2 follows**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
